name: Opacity Rendering with SH Colors
definition: A rendering pass that uses the model's actual opacity values and precomputes colors from Spherical Harmonics (SH) in Python before rasterization, allowing the rasterizer to use precomputed colors.
summary: Opacity Rendering with SH Colors precomputes Spherical Harmonics coefficients to RGB in Python, allowing the rasterizer to use fixed colors instead of differentiable SH kernels.
